formulas.total_opex: personnel + marketing + network_and_processing + professional_fees + depreciation_and_amortization + general_and_administrative + litigation_provision

net_revenue_yoy.description: Net revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

opex_margin_delta_bps.description: Total operating expenses as % of net revenue, delta vs Q-4

interest_expense_yoy.description: interest_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

investment_income_other_abs.description: investment_income_other absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
